author: Discovery
description:
Watch as Forrest Galante uncovers the world's freakiest, rarest, and most unbelievable shark discoveries! From the elusive Pondicherry shark in the Maldives to giant Japanese swellsharks, and bizarre carpet sharks in Australia, he travels the globe in search of some of the world's strangest sharks and more!

#SharkWeek returns July 26th on Discovery!

#SharkWeek #Discovery
